extension.description: Remote Pulse — a quiet, native-feeling indicator that continuously tracks your Remote-SSH host's CPU/memory/disk/network/GPU/Docker status.
command.showTrend.title: Remote Pulse: Show Trend Chart
command.refresh.title: Remote Pulse: Refresh Now
command.showLogs.title: Remote Pulse: Show Logs
command.configureStatusBarMetrics.title: Remote Pulse: Configure Status Bar Metrics
command.configureTrendPanelSections.titl: Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Panel Sections
command.configureTrendChartMetrics.title: Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Chart Metrics
config.refreshInterval.description: Refresh interval for high-frequency foreground metrics (CPU/memory/network), in milliseconds
config.backgroundInterval.description: Reduced refresh interval used once the window loses focus, in milliseconds
config.heavyMetricInterval.description: Separate polling interval for low-frequency metrics (disk, GPU, Docker, processes), in milliseconds
config.warningThreshold.description: Warning threshold (percentage); the status bar switches to the warning color above it. If it ends up higher than the critical threshold, the two are swapped.
config.criticalThreshold.description: Critical threshold (percentage); the status bar switches to the critical color above it
config.gpuTempWarningThreshold.descripti: GPU temperature warning threshold, in °C. Kept separate from the percentage thresholds because °C and % are not the same scale.
config.statusBarMetrics.description: Which metrics to show as status bar items; the rest still appear in the trend panel. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Status Bar Metrics" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.statusBarMetrics.markdownDescript: Which metrics to show as status bar items; the rest still appear in the trend panel. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Status Bar Metrics` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.statusBarMetrics.gpu.description: GPU utilization of a single GPU (chosen by remotePulse.gpuSelection); all GPUs still appear in the trend panel
config.statusBarMetrics.network.descript: Network download/upload rate, shown separately with arrow icons
config.statusBarAlignment.description: Which side of the status bar the Remote Pulse items live on. Changing it rebuilds the items.
config.statusBarAlignment.left.descripti: Left side, next to the remote indicator
config.statusBarAlignment.right.descript: Right side, next to the language/encoding indicators
config.trendPanelSections.description: Which optional sections to show in the trend panel; System and Storage are always shown. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Panel Sections" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendPanelSections.markdownDescri: Which optional sections to show in the trend panel; System and Storage are always shown. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Panel Sections` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendPanelSections.network.descri: Network upload/download rate, shown as a row in the panel's System section
config.trendPanelSections.diskIo.descrip: Disk read/write throughput, shown as a row in the panel's Storage section
config.trendPanelSections.processes.desc: Top processes by CPU usage (reads /proc; off by default because it is the most expensive collector)
config.trendPanelSections.docker.descrip: Docker container info (requires access to docker.sock)
config.trendChartMetrics.description: Which metrics to plot as lines in the trend panel's chart; independent of trendPanelSections (which controls the detail sections, not the chart) and statusBarMetrics. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Chart Metrics" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendChartMetrics.markdownDescrip: Which metrics to plot as lines in the trend panel's chart; independent of `trendPanelSections` (which controls the detail sections, not the chart) and `statusBarMetrics`. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Trend Chart Metrics` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.trendChartMetrics.gpu.description: GPU utilization of a single GPU (chosen by remotePulse.gpuSelection); requires nvidia-smi
config.trendChartMetrics.network.descrip: Network download/upload rate, plotted as two separate lines on their own right-hand axis
config.trendWindowMinutes.description: How much history the trend chart covers, in minutes. The in-memory history size follows this value and the refresh interval.
config.notificationMetrics.description: Which metrics may raise a critical notification. Disk is included by default because a full disk is more damaging than a busy CPU. Run "Remote Pulse: Configure Notification Metrics" from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.notificationMetrics.markdownDescr: Which metrics may raise a critical notification. Disk is included by default because a full disk is more damaging than a busy CPU. Run `Remote Pulse: Configure Notification Metrics` from the Command Palette to pick from all options at once.
config.notificationMetrics.disk.descript: Disk usage of any monitored mount point
config.enableNotifications.description: Whether to show a system notification when the critical threshold is crossed. The notification offers "Mute for 1 hour".
config.diskMountPoints.description: Disk mount points to monitor; leave empty to show every real mount point, sorted by usage
config.networkInterfaces.description: Network interfaces to measure; leave empty to use every physical interface (virtual ones such as docker0/veth*/br-*/tun* are excluded, since their traffic is internal or double-counted)
config.gpuSelection.description: Which GPU the status bar summary and the chart line represent on a multi-GPU host
config.gpuSelection.busiest.description: Whichever GPU currently has the highest utilization
config.topProcessCount.description: How many processes the "Top Processes" section lists
config.dockerMaxContainers.description: Maximum number of containers to pull per-container stats for; the rest only count toward the total. Each stats call costs about a second on the daemon side.
config.cgroupAware.description: Inside a container (Dev Container, Codespaces), report CPU/memory against the cgroup quota instead of the host's /proc values
config.cgroupAware.markdownDescription: Inside a container (Dev Container, Codespaces), report CPU/memory against the cgroup quota instead of the host's `/proc` values. A container limited to 2 GB otherwise shows the host's 64 GB usage, which answers a question you did not ask.
